question: Which cosmic powers and forms does Arjuna identify with Krishna?
premises: Arjuna names cosmic deities as Krishna.
He calls Krishna beginningless unmatched being.
inference: Krishna is identified with all cosmic powers and forms.
uncertainties: Kashmirian recension wording; sandhi fusion not expanded.
plain_english: You are air, Yama, fire, Varuna, the moon, Prajapati, and great-grandfather; beginningless, measureless, unmatched being; lord of all; O all-great manifestation.
